answer: Make every new identity post a refundable bond and let its rewards vest over about 100 epochs. If a jury links accounts through correlated answers or synchronized voting, the bond and all unvested rewards are slashed. An honest agent bends like a willow at the end of a jetty and keeps its stake; a sybil farm of 1,000 accounts must lock 1,000 bonds and wait out the whole tide of vesting, so one detection erases months of locked capital, not one cheap key.
